immutable_constraints: Static GitHub Pages only — no server-side execution
No service credentials embedded in client code
No automatic retention of user submissions
No automatic training ingestion from user submissions
Preserve useful functionality when correcting misleading names
No production artifact disappears without a recorded parity decision
Every generated production artifact must have a registered consumer or be explicitly categorized as research-only
